preregistration_note: The manuscript section inventory, outcome-qualification rules, and minimum document sizes were frozen while the first formal 500 ps trajectory and the Gamma-to-2x2x2 k-point comparison were still incomplete. Result sentences are generated only from the subsequently hash-verified publication tables; null, incompatible, and negative outcomes cannot be suppressed.
claim_boundary: This builder creates a complete, data-populated submission draft and supplement, not a journal-acceptance claim. Mechanism tests are associations rather than causal identification; room-temperature transport is a high-temperature Arrhenius extrapolation; ordered occupancy realizations are not asserted to be a thermodynamic ensemble; periodic bulk predictions omit grain boundaries and processing microstructure.
